description: List the HelloFresh box sizes this subscription can switch to — meals per week × people (servings), with the SKU that names it — and mark the current plan size.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact is one flat list sorted by meals then people; full keeps HelloFresh’s product groups.

name: hf_list_box_sizes
